# PDF HTML5 Page Flip Pro

> A high-performance, client-side 3D HTML5 flipbook web application and React component for PDF documents.

## Project Summary
- Repository: https://github.com/iamapinan/pdf-html5-page-flip
- Demo: https://flipbook.apps.gracer.ai
- License: Apache-2.0
- Author: Apinan Worawichitsilp (@iamapinan)

## Key Technical Specifications
- 100% Client-Side Privacy: Decodes & renders PDF binary streams directly in-browser using Mozilla PDF.js & Web Workers.
- 60 FPS 3D Page Peel Physics: Realistic page turning simulation with cubic-bezier easing and responsive single/double page layout.
- Synthesized Web Audio: Dynamically synthesizes paper friction audio without external audio files.
- Full-Text Search & Native PDF Outlines: In-memory inverted index and extracted PDF bookmarks.
- On-Demand AI Document Summaries: Active viewport text extraction with client-side summarization.
- React Component: `<PdfFlipbook src="/document.pdf" ... />`

## Quick Start
```bash
npm install @iamapinan/pdf-html5-page-flip
```

```tsx
import { PdfFlipbook } from '@iamapinan/pdf-html5-page-flip/react';
import '@iamapinan/pdf-html5-page-flip/style.css';

export default function DocumentViewer() {
  return (
    <div style={{ width: '100vw', height: '100vh' }}>
      <PdfFlipbook
        src="/sample.pdf"
        accentColor="#f43f5e"
        enableSound={true}
        enableAiSummary={true}
        onPageChange={(current, total) => console.log(`Page ${current} of ${total}`)}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```
